messages.text:
Your previous carafe proposal expired before payment: refund proposals are valid for 72 hours, after which a new one is needed. (refund-policy/v2/validity)

I’ve created a new proposal for **BRL 119.90**. Please confirm using the **button on the proposal card**; a typed “yes” does not count. A staff member must then approve it before payment. (refund-policy/v2/amount) (refund-policy/v2/approval)

A debit card payment can be refunded automatically to the **original payment**, provided the order has exactly one valid payment record and all refund requirements are met—not simply because it was paid by debit card. (refund-policy/v2/payment) (refund-policy/v2/payout) In this demo, the receipt records a refund in the shop’s test ledger, not a bank transfer, and no date is promised for it to appear on a card. (refund-policy/v2/payout)
